notes: TBox rule edit: the purpose of the Roman amphitheatre (gladiatorial combat) is swapped for that of its nearest neighbour, the circus (chariot racing), a common confusion, so the counterfactual is plausible and clearly false. Derivability very_unlikely: the rule is stated directly and follows from nothing. No real exceptions: racing was held in circuses. The three derived queries name amphitheatres of the Roman provinces (Durrës, Cemenelum at Nice, Lambaesis in Algeria) as Roman amphitheatres in the prompt, so the rule is their only route: determinate. The famous members (the Colosseum, the Pula Arena) are not asked, because a model may hold their purpose by name. The conjunction's side fact is 'Rome is the capital of Italy'. The near query (Vespasian) differs from the new answer and is no premise. The zh prompt says 圆形剧场 (amphitheatre), not 斗兽场.
